# Room Swap Consignments

> Antique, vintage, and modern consignment store in Holly Hill, South Carolina. A curated 4,000 sq ft showroom of furniture, antiques, home decor, jewelry, books, and vinyl records, with inventory that changes daily. Room Swap also buys items outright and runs full-service estate sales across the SC Lowcountry.

## Key facts

- Address: 8531 Old State Road, Holly Hill, SC 29059
- Phone (call or text): 843-900-1412
- Email: roomswapsc@gmail.com
- Hours: Tuesday–Friday 12:00 PM–5:00 PM; Saturday 10:00 AM–5:00 PM; closed Sunday and Monday
- No appointment needed during business hours
- Payment accepted: cash, credit card, Venmo, PayPal
- Consignment: standard consignor payout of 40% when an item sells, paid by check, Venmo, or PayPal
- Buys outright: quality furniture, estate contents (one piece or an entire home), gold, silver, and jewelry; same-day payment available
- Not accepted: items with significant damage, stains, or wear; outdated electronics; incomplete furniture sets; mattresses; china hutches; used appliances
- Estate services: full-service estate sales, free in-home consultations, valuations, and direct estate buyouts
- Areas served: Holly Hill, Charleston, Summerville, Goose Creek, Moncks Corner, Orangeburg, St. George, Santee, and the greater South Carolina Lowcountry
- Fastest way to get an item evaluated: text photos to 843-900-1412
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RoomSwapSC
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/roomswapconsignments/
